in_sanskrit.name: Haran
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है One who removes
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Haran एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। In Hindu mythology, Haran is the name of a demon king who was vanquished by Lord Rama. The name Haran signifies 'one who removes' or 'one who takes away'. It is also a variant of the name Hara, which means 'thief' in Sanskrit.
